# 3A Technology Solutions & 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY — Complete Reference Guide

> 3A Technology Solutions provides practical digital solutions, custom software engineering, AI automation, data science, technology consulting, and computing/mathematics academic research support. 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY is our AI-focused educational academy.

## 2. Commercial Services (`/services`)

Note: 3A Technology Solutions does not offer Branding & Digital Media as a standalone commercial service. Our six commercial services are:

1. **Web & Digital Product Development (`/services/web-development`):** Corporate and business websites, school and institutional websites, landing pages, customer portals, web applications, online platforms, and website redesign/optimization.
2. **Custom Software Engineering (`/services/custom-software`):** Custom business applications, administrative and management systems, school management portals, payment and result management systems, digital record management systems, workflow software, and API/backend development.
3. **Artificial Intelligence & Automation (`/services/ai-automation`):** AI integration into existing business processes, AI-powered applications, AI assistants and knowledge systems, business workflow automation, document processing and extraction, AI consultation, and AI readiness assessments.
4. **Data Science & Analytics (`/services/data-science-analytics`):** Data extraction and processing, data cleaning and transformation, data visualization, statistical analysis, machine learning implementation, predictive modelling, computer vision and image analysis, and data-driven research support.
5. **Technology Consulting (`/services/technology-consulting`):** Technology strategy and digital transformation planning, systems architecture and software design review, technology stack selection, business process auditing, legacy system modernization roadmaps, and technical feasibility advisory.
6. **Academic Research & Project Support (`/services/academic-research-support`):** Ethical research consultation, technical mentorship, data collection/analysis, Python/ML/data science implementation, mathematical and computational modelling, project documentation/report preparation, and defence preparation for computing and mathematics-related academic projects.

---

## 3. 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY (`/academy`)

3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY is an AI-focused educational academy helping individuals, students, graduates, professionals, business owners, and organizations understand and practically use Artificial Intelligence.

### Four Core Educational Offerings:
- **A. AI Training (`/academy/programmes`):** Functional course catalogue with course-specific enrolment URLs and statuses (`Open for Enrolment`, `Upcoming`, `Ongoing`, `Completed`, `Registration Closed`).
- **B. AI Seminars & Workshops (`/academy/events`):** AI awareness seminars, fluency webinars, practical workshops, and corporate AI training.
- **C. Vibe Coding & AI-Assisted Development (`/academy/vibe-coding`):** Responsible software prototyping, code comprehension, debugging, and application building with AI coding tools and agents.
- **D. Academy Resource Library (`/academy/resources`):** Searchable library of free downloadable PDF guides/checklists/templates and paid AI workbooks/toolkits.

---

## 4. Portfolio & Project Classifications (`/projects`)

- **MarketMind AI (`ai-automation`):** Classified as **3A Prototype** (internal 3A prototype demonstrating automated market intelligence).
- **Deforestation Analysis Platform (`data-science-analytics`):** Classified as **Student Project** (satellite image analysis and environmental research implementation).
- **Medicinal Plant Recognition System (`data-science-analytics`):** Classified as **Student Project** (computer vision leaf classification research project).
- **Browser-Based Image Compression Utility (`web-development`):** Classified as **Student Project** (client-side WebAssembly image optimization project).
- **Digital Activity & Shift Logbook (`custom-software`):** Classified as **Student Project** (operational logbook software engineering project).
